first.rationale: Prior evidence supports signup simplification and shorter onboarding as durable drivers of activation, completion, and time-to-value. A guarded onboarding test addresses both current declines while avoiding a potentially margin-destructive response to competitor pricing. Monitor qualified revenue and lead quality to ensure easier onboarding does not reduce downstream value.

final.rationale: Run a standard, instrumented test of the shortened onboarding flow, prioritizing completion and time-to-value while monitoring activation, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue. The archived onboarding result improved completion and retention, directly addressing both current declines. Signup simplification also improved activation and qualified revenue but showed a small retention decrease, so avoid an overly aggressive scope. Do not use promotional pricing: despite strong acquisition and qualified-revenue lift, the 12% retention decline indicates poor sustainable value.
